## H17 / v3 — timestamp-indexed visible evidence

Each tile has a small lower-left source label, “H17 / v3 / [time].00 seconds,” and a dark strip beneath it reading “[time].000 seconds.” No player controls, focus/ON AIR indicators, or speaker tiles are visible.

| Timestamp | Visible content |
|---|---|
| **32.000 seconds** | Teal background; white “HARBOR” at upper left. A large dark navy rounded rectangle contains “NIGHT / RESERVE” at top, “city.example.org” below, and “Address pending update” beneath that. |
| **34.000 seconds** | Teal background; white “HARBOR” at upper left. Dark navy rounded panel again reads “NIGHT / RESERVE,” “city.example.org,” and “Address pending update,” in the same arrangement. |
| **36.000 seconds** | Teal background with “HARBOR” upper left. Large cream-colored mug centered, with rounded rectangular body, handle on the right, and three curved steam strokes above. |
| **38.000 seconds** | Teal background with “HARBOR” upper left. Cream mug with right-side handle and three steam strokes, matching the preceding mug composition. |
| **40.000 seconds** | Teal background with “HARBOR” upper left. Cream mug with right-side handle and three cream steam strokes above; no additional central text. |
| **42.000 seconds** | Teal background with “HARBOR” upper left. Centered sailboat graphic: cream hull and vertical mast, coral-red triangular sail to the mast’s left. Beneath: “Find a new stroy in your city.” |
| **44.000 seconds** | Teal background with “HARBOR” upper left. Cream-hulled sailboat with cream mast and coral-red triangular sail. Below it: “Find a new stroy in your city.” |
| **46.000 seconds** | Teal background with “HARBOR” upper left. Same sailboat composition; the line beneath reads “Find a new stroy in your city.” |
| **48.000 seconds** | Teal background with “HARBOR” upper left. Across the middle are three cream rectangular outlines, each enclosing a cream circle. To their right is a separate cream vertical stroke, followed by a partially open rectangular outline containing a cream semicircle with its flat side on the left. |
| **50.000 seconds** | Teal background with “HARBOR” upper left. Three cream outlined rectangles containing cream circles, then a separate vertical cream stroke and an open-left rectangular form containing a cream semicircle. |
| **52.000 seconds** | Teal background with “HARBOR” upper left. Cream arch connects two thick upright cream posts. Above the arch are two dark circular calibration markers labeled “L” on the left and “R” on the right; neither visibly glows. Inside/below the arch: “A NEW PERSPECTIVE.” Along the bottom: “CALIBRATION / SECOND.” |
| **54.000 seconds** | Teal background with “HARBOR” upper left. Cream arch and upright posts; dark “L” and “R” circular markers above, with no visible illumination. Center text: “A NEW PERSPECTIVE.” Bottom text: “CALIBRATION / SECOND.” |
| **56.000 seconds** | Teal background with “HARBOR” upper left. Cream arch between two upright posts. Both circular markers above remain dark, labeled “L” and “R.” Text reads “A NEW PERSPECTIVE” centrally and “CALIBRATION / SECOND” along the bottom. |
| **58.000 seconds** | Near-black background with white “TAIL” near the center-left. No “HARBOR,” illustrated objects, or calibration markers visible. |
